How loud this menu's song is.
How much FSR 1 sharpens the enlarged picture. HIGH is crispest but can make edges look harsh; LOW is gentler.
How sharp floors, walls and streets stay when seen at an angle. Higher is sharper; the PS5's GPU handles 16X easily.
How the picture is enlarged to your TV's resolution (up to 4K). FSR 1, AMD's upscaler, keeps edges and detail sharp at almost no cost to the frame rate; BILINEAR is a plain, softer stretch.

The game's text, menus and subtitles, and this menu's: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Portuguese (Brazil) (the voices are English in all of them). AUTO follows the PS5's own language, or English when the game doesn't have it. The game takes it when you PLAY.

The light bar follows Raiden's health: blue when he's well, to red as it runs low, a flash when he's hit, white as Zandatsu repairs him, deep red in Ripper Mode. L2 (Blade Mode) pushes back while there's fuel for it, R2 (Ninja Run) gives a little, and hits rumble harder.
